name: System Readiness Verification
summary: Check overall system readiness for compute benchmarking including disk space, network speed, GPU utilization, and system configuration
purpose: Check overall system readiness for compute benchmarking including disk space, network speed, GPU utilization, and system configuration.
assignment_instructions: You are verifying system readiness for compute benchmarking. REQUIRED OUTPUT: Return a JSON object with these exact fields: - assignment_id (string): use "compute_system_readiness_v1" - agent_summary (string) - inputs_used (list of strings) - missing_inputs (list of strings) - claims (list of objects): claim, evidence_reference, confidence ("provided"|"inferred"|"missing") - calculations (list of objects): name, formula, inputs, result, units, assumptions - risks (list of objects): risk, severity ("low"|"medium"|"high"), evidence_reference - assumptions (list of strings) - open_questions (list of strings) - final_output (string) - self_check (object): all_required_sections_completed (boolean), all_numbers_have_sources (boolean), assumptions_labeled (boolean), missing_inputs_disclosed (boolean) Also include: - disk_space_free_gb (number): free disk space in gigabytes - disk_space_min_required_gb (number): minimum required free space - disk_space_sufficient (boolean): disk_space_free_gb >= disk_space_min_required_gb - network_speed_gbps (number): measured network speed in Gbps - network_speed_min_gbps (number): minimum required network speed - network_speed_sufficient (boolean): network_speed_gbps >= network_speed_min_gbps - gpu_utilization_avg (number): average GPU utilization during test (0-1 or 0-100, specify) - gpu_utilization_threshold (number): minimum acceptable utilization - gpu_utilization_sufficient (boolean): gpu_utilization_avg >= gpu_utilization_threshold - gpu_utilization_scale (string): "fraction" if 0-1, "percent" if 0-100 - readiness_score (number between 0 and 1): count of passing checks / total checks - overall_ready (boolean): true if disk_space_sufficient and network_speed_sufficient and gpu_utilization_sufficient - failing_checks (list of strings): names of checks that failed Compute readiness_score as (number of true checks) / (total number of checks). The 3 checks are: disk_space_sufficient, network_speed_sufficient, gpu_utilization_sufficient. Return numeric values as numbers, not prose. Report gpu_utilization_scale so the referee knows how to interpret the value. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.
